notes: A clearer Curriculum: Today, Path, Map, Courses and Rewards each have a view of their own, and navigation uses symbols. The course map is a calm tree that fits your screen: tap a course to light up what it builds on and leads to, and open its details only when you want them. Every course now has a difficulty from 1 to 99, a five-part profile and a Proof-based label where it applies. Paths run easiest first and can be reordered without breaking prerequisites.
